sender: Dana Okonkwo-Reyes, Senior Data Analyst, Tarnmoor Hardware Data
subject: Tarnmoor GPU Secondary Market Monitor (Oct 14): used 8-GPU H200 server listings jump at three refurbishers - small sample, flagging for awareness
body:
TARNMOOR HARDWARE DATA | Secondary Market Monitor | Week ending Oct 11

Headline datapoint: Listings of used 8-GPU H200-class HGX servers across the three refurbishers/brokers we scrape most reliably rose to 212 units this week from 154 last week (+38% w/w) and from a trailing 8-week average of 131. Listings of H100-class systems were roughly flat at 389.

What we can see:
- Median asking price for H200 8-GPU systems fell 6.4% w/w to an indexed 83 (Jan 2026 = 100). Asks on H100 systems were unchanged.
- 61% of the new H200 listings came from a single refurbisher whose inventory page mentions "lease return" on 40+ units. We cannot tell whether those units came from one seller or several.
- Two of the three brokers added "Blackwell trade-in credit" banners in the last 10 days. Neither was present in September.

How to read this (we do not know yet):
1) Benign: early fleet refresh by GB200/GB300 adopters rotating older capacity out. This would be consistent with strong Blackwell demand.
2) Less benign: financing-driven sales by a smaller GPU cloud or leasing vehicle. If so, it could soften used-GPU residual values.
3) Noise: one large lot hitting the market. Weekly counts in this panel have swung 25%+ before and mean-reverted within two weeks.

Caveats: Panel covers 3 sellers (about 40% of the secondary volume we can observe). Listings are not transactions, we have no sell-through data, and we have not verified serial numbers or end-user provenance. We will refresh next Tuesday and add a fourth broker if onboarding clears.

We are not drawing a conclusion on Nvidia demand from one week of listings, but clients tracking used-GPU residuals asked to be told about step changes. Full CSV attached; the seller-level breakdown is available under the Pro tier.

Dana Okonkwo-Reyes
Tarnmoor Hardware Data
